newsitem.title: BELARUS: New finance minister appointed in Belarus.
newsitem.headline: New finance minister appointed in Belarus.

text.p: Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko issued a decree on Thursday appointing acting central bank chairman Nikolai Korbut to the post of Finance Minister.
Korbut replaced Filip Rimos who served in the position since the beginning of 1997.
Changes in key government positions, made by Lukashenko's decrees, are frequent in the former Soviet republic of 10 million people.
Former central bank head Tamara Vinnikova is under arrest and being investigated for alleged wrongdoings in her post which she held until the beginning of this year.
